text:
maria: Quick sync — proposal: add a 'liveness' + 'handshake_reason' field to fallback events so operators can see why the router chose degrade mode. Example: `handshake_reason: "route_unhealthy" / "quota_exceeded" / "model_timeout"`. Thoughts? @jon @sam :thinking:
jon: +1 on visibility. One ask: keep reasons small enums not big strings. Also surface last-successful-ping timestamp.
sam: We need to ensure it's privacy-safe (no user prompt contents). Handshake should be meta-only. Also how do we show in console? small pill?
taylor: UI protos: two lines — small pill with reason + hover with timeline. I'll drop screenshots later.
lucy: telemetry: add metric `fallback.handshake.{reason}` and tag with `route_id` and `model_variant`. Also include `latency_bucket`.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `fallback-reason-field` -> canary=5% -> status OK
maria: For audit: retention 90 days by default and ability to export. Any regulatory concerns? @taylor
jon: audit log should record full decision trace id (not prompt). We can map to trace id for later playback.
sam: Internal API: route decision returns `fallback_reason` and `decision_trace_id`. We need to version it `v1beta2`.
taylor: UX question: do we show reasons to customers in Dedicated console? probably opt-in. We should default to internal-only.
lucy: Query performance: storing per-request handshake blobs will blow up db. Better to sample 1% and full store for incidents.
maria: Agree sampling default 1% + 100/day per route for high-sensitivity routes. Add toggle in console.
jon: Edge case: cascading fallbacks (fallback to cheaper model then to mock). We should record chain as `fallback_chain: ["model_a","model_b","mock"]` but keep chain length limit 5.
sam: Implementation note: runtime should attach `handshake_meta` to existing `request` proto. Backwards compatible if field absent.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout finished -> promoted -> status SUCCESS :tada:
maria: OK next steps: sam + jon to spec API, lucy to spec metrics, taylor to mockups, I'll open RFC.
jon: I'll add simple schema in PR: `handshake_reason: enum`, `decision_trace_id: string`, `fallback_chain: repeated string`
sam: timeline: PR by EOD Wednesday, canary next week.
maria: thx everyone :heart:
